title: Specify the capture format and device style up front (Vertical 9:16, smartphone…
content:
Specify the capture format and device style up front (Vertical 9:16, smartphone vlog, shot on iPhone) to lock the aesthetic.

Force a continuous shot by explicitly prompting ONE SINGLE UNINTERRUPTED HANDHELD TAKE with a target duration (e.g., ~30 seconds) and stating no cuts/no editing.

Control pacing and camera language by listing the exact moves you want (quick whip pans, pans/tilts/zooms/walking) and adding “camera never lingers.”

Get realistic phone footage by prompting natural hand micro-shake + walking bounce + slightly floaty digital stabilization.

Avoid “cinematic” drift by explicitly banning it (no cinematic bokeh, no film look, no color grading, deep focus with everything sharp).

Increase smartphone realism by prompting auto-exposure/auto white balance readjusting on pans, slight highlight clipping, autofocus hunting on fast pans, and digital zoom quality drop + extra shake.

Lock the location continuity by stating “same block for the entire take” and describing consistent environmental anchors (brick facades, fire escapes, sidewalk café, parked cars).

Constrain audio by specifying raw street ambience only and explicitly excluding music, captions, and watermark.

Use character reference images with a strict CHARACTER LOCK rule (face/hair/skin/build/clothing never change; no swapping) to maintain identity consistency.

Prevent unwanted reappearances by timeboxing each character’s appearance (e.g., “Appears ONLY at 0:09–0:13”) and adding “no stand-ins/doubles/background extras resembling named characters.”

Storyboard the whole clip with timestamped beats (0:00–0:05, 0:05–0:09, etc.) and describe the exact camera transition between beats (flip to rear camera, whip RIGHT, slide+zoom, tilt up, swing forward/left).

Enforce outfit/face continuity across separated moments by adding an explicit consistency rule (e.g., vlogger at 0:28 must match 0:00 exactly).

Keep the phone out of frame by stating “the vlogger’s phone IS the camera—it never appears on screen.”

es.content:
Especifica por adelantado el formato de captura y el estilo del dispositivo (Vertical 9:16, smartphone vlog, shot on iPhone) para fijar la estética.

Fuerza una toma continua indicando explícitamente ONE SINGLE UNINTERRUPTED HANDHELD TAKE con una duración objetivo (p. ej., ~30 seconds) y dejando claro que no hay cuts ni editing.

Controla el ritmo y el lenguaje de cámara enumerando los movimientos exactos que quieres (quick whip pans, pans/tilts/zooms/walking) y añadiendo “camera never lingers.”

Consigue metraje realista de teléfono indicando natural hand micro-shake + walking bounce + slightly floaty digital stabilization.

Evita el drift “cinematic” prohibiéndolo explícitamente (no cinematic bokeh, no film look, no color grading, deep focus with everything sharp).

Aumenta el realismo de smartphone indicando auto-exposure/auto white balance readjusting on pans, slight highlight clipping, autofocus hunting on fast pans, y digital zoom quality drop + extra shake.

Bloquea la continuidad de la ubicación diciendo “same block for the entire take” y describiendo anclas ambientales consistentes (brick facades, fire escapes, sidewalk café, parked cars).

Restringe el audio especificando solo raw street ambience y excluyendo explícitamente music, captions y watermark.

Usa imágenes de referencia del personaje con una regla estricta de CHARACTER LOCK (face/hair/skin/build/clothing never change; no swapping) para mantener la consistencia de identidad.

Evita reapariciones no deseadas limitando temporalmente la aparición de cada personaje (p. ej., “Appears ONLY at 0:09–0:13”) y añadiendo “no stand-ins/doubles/background extras resembling named characters.”

Haz un storyboard de todo el clip con beats con marca de tiempo (0:00–0:05, 0:05–0:09, etc.) y describe la transición exacta de cámara entre beats (flip to rear camera, whip RIGHT, slide+zoom, tilt up, swing forward/left).

Impón la continuidad de outfit/face entre momentos separados añadiendo una regla explícita de consistencia (p. ej., el vlogger at 0:28 must match 0:00 exactly).

Mantén el teléfono fuera de cuadro diciendo “the vlogger’s phone IS the camera—it never appears on screen.”

fr.content:
Spécifiez dès le départ le format de capture et le style de l’appareil (Vertical 9:16, smartphone vlog, shot on iPhone) pour verrouiller l’esthétique.

Forcez un plan continu en demandant explicitement ONE SINGLE UNINTERRUPTED HANDHELD TAKE avec une durée cible (par ex. ~30 seconds) et en précisant no cuts/no editing.

Contrôlez le rythme et le langage caméra en listant les mouvements exacts souhaités (quick whip pans, pans/tilts/zooms/walking) et en ajoutant “camera never lingers.”

Obtenez des images de téléphone réalistes en demandant natural hand micro-shake + walking bounce + slightly floaty digital stabilization.

Évitez la dérive “cinematic” en l’interdisant explicitement (no cinematic bokeh, no film look, no color grading, deep focus with everything sharp).

Renforcez le réalisme smartphone en demandant auto-exposure/auto white balance readjusting on pans, slight highlight clipping, autofocus hunting on fast pans, et digital zoom quality drop + extra shake.

Verrouillez la continuité du lieu en indiquant “same block for the entire take” et en décrivant des repères environnementaux cohérents (brick facades, fire escapes, sidewalk café, parked cars).

Contraignez l’audio en précisant raw street ambience only et en excluant explicitement music, captions, and watermark.

Utilisez des images de référence du personnage avec une règle stricte de CHARACTER LOCK (face/hair/skin/build/clothing never change; no swapping) pour maintenir la cohérence d’identité.

Empêchez les réapparitions indésirables en limitant dans le temps l’apparition de chaque personnage (par ex. “Appears ONLY at 0:09–0:13”) et en ajoutant “no stand-ins/doubles/background extras resembling named characters.”

Storyboardez tout le clip avec des repères horodatés (0:00–0:05, 0:05–0:09, etc.) et décrivez la transition caméra exacte entre les segments (flip to rear camera, whip RIGHT, slide+zoom, tilt up, swing forward/left).

Imposez la continuité de la tenue et du visage entre des moments séparés en ajoutant une règle explicite de cohérence (par ex. le vlogger à 0:28 must match 0:00 exactly).

Gardez le téléphone hors champ en indiquant “the vlogger’s phone IS the camera—it never appears on screen.”

ja.content:
撮影フォーマットとデバイスのスタイルを最初に明示しておく（Vertical 9:16、スマートフォン vlog、shot on iPhone）ことで、見た目の方向性を固定する。

**ONE SINGLE UNINTERRUPTED HANDHELD TAKE** と、目標尺（例：~30 seconds）を明示して、さらに no cuts / no editing と指定し、連続ショットを強制する。

正確に欲しい動きを列挙することで、テンポとカメラ言語をコントロールする（quick whip pans、pans/tilts/zooms/walking）うえで、“camera never lingers.” を追加する。

自然な手ブレ + walking bounce + やや浮遊感のある digital stabilization をプロンプトして、リアルなスマホ映像にする。

“cinematic” への逸脱を防ぐため、明示的に禁止する（no cinematic bokeh、no film look、no color grading、deep focus with everything sharp）。

auto-exposure / auto white balance がパン時に再調整されること、わずかな highlight clipping、fast pans での autofocus hunting、digital zoom の画質低下 + 余分な揺れをプロンプトして、スマートフォンらしさを高める。

“same block for the entire take” と明記し、brick facades、fire escapes、sidewalk café、parked cars など一貫した環境のアンカーを描写して、ロケーションの連続性を固定する。

raw street ambience only を指定し、music、captions、watermark を明確に除外して、音声を制約する。

キャラクター参照画像を使う際は、厳格な CHARACTER LOCK ルールを設ける（face/hair/skin/build/clothing never change; no swapping）ことで、アイデンティティの一貫性を維持する。

各キャラクターの登場時間を timebox する（例: “Appears ONLY at 0:09–0:13”）うえで、“no stand-ins/doubles/background extras resembling named characters.” を追加し、不要な再登場を防ぐ。

クリップ全体を timestamped beats（0:00–0:05、0:05–0:09 など）で storyboard 化し、各ビート間の正確な camera transition を記述する（flip to rear camera、whip RIGHT、slide+zoom、tilt up、swing forward/left）。

分かれた時点間でも outfit/face continuity を保つため、明示的な consistency rule を追加する（例: 0:28 の vlogger は 0:00 と完全に一致していなければならない）。

“the vlogger’s phone IS the camera—it never appears on screen.” と明記して、スマホがフレーム内に入らないようにする。

ko.content:
캡처 형식과 기기 스타일을 처음부터 명시하세요(Vertical 9:16, smartphone vlog, shot on iPhone) — 그래야 미학이 고정됩니다.

지속적인 샷을 강제하려면, 정확한 길이(예: 약 30초)를 포함해 ONE SINGLE UNINTERRUPTED HANDHELD TAKE를 명시적으로 프롬프트하고, no cuts/no editing이라고 적으세요.

원하는 정확한 움직임을 나열하고(quick whip pans, pans/tilts/zooms/walking), “camera never lingers.”를 추가해 페이싱과 카메라 언어를 제어하세요.

자연스러운 손의 미세한 흔들림 + 걷는 바운스 + 약간 떠 있는 듯한 디지털 안정화 효과를 프롬프트해 현실적인 휴대폰 영상을 얻으세요.

“cinematic” 드리프트를 피하려면 이를 명시적으로 금지하세요(no cinematic bokeh, no film look, no color grading, deep focus with everything sharp).

스마트폰의 사실감을 높이려면, 팬할 때 auto-exposure/auto white balance가 재조정되는 것, 약간의 highlight clipping, 빠른 팬에서 autofocus hunting, 그리고 디지털 줌 품질 저하 + 추가 흔들림을 프롬프트하세요.

“same block for the entire take”라고 명시하고, 벽돌 외벽, fire escapes, sidewalk café, parked cars처럼 일관된 환경 앵커를 묘사해 장소의 연속성을 고정하세요.

오디오는 raw street ambience only로 지정하고, music, captions, watermark는 명시적으로 제외해 제약하세요.

캐릭터 참조 이미지를 엄격한 CHARACTER LOCK 규칙과 함께 사용해 정체성 일관성을 유지하세요(얼굴/머리/피부/체형/의상은 절대 바뀌지 않음; no swapping).

원치 않는 재등장을 막으려면 각 캐릭터의 등장 시간을 제한하고(예: “Appears ONLY at 0:09–0:13”), “no stand-ins/doubles/background extras resembling named characters.”를 추가하세요.

타임스탬프가 있는 비트(0:00–0:05, 0:05–0:09 등)로 전체 클립을 스토리보드화하고, 비트 사이의 정확한 카메라 전환을 설명하세요(flip to rear camera, whip RIGHT, slide+zoom, tilt up, swing forward/left).

분리된 순간들 사이의 의상/얼굴 연속성을 강제하려면 명시적인 일관성 규칙을 추가하세요(예: 0:28의 vlogger는 0:00과 정확히 일치해야 함).

“the vlogger’s phone IS the camera—it never appears on screen.”라고 명시해 휴대폰이 프레임에 나오지 않도록 하세요.

pt.content:
Especifique antecipadamente o formato de captura e o estilo do dispositivo (Vertical 9:16, smartphone vlog, filmado no iPhone) para travar a estética.

Force uma tomada contínua explicitando ONE SINGLE UNINTERRUPTED HANDHELD TAKE com uma duração-alvo (por exemplo, ~30 segundos) e informando sem cortes/sem edição.

Controle o ritmo e a linguagem de câmera listando os movimentos exatos que você quer (quick whip pans, pans/tilts/zooms/walking) e adicionando “camera never lingers.”

Obtenha imagens realistas de celular pedindo natural hand micro-shake + walking bounce + slightly floaty digital stabilization.

Evite o desvio para “cinematic” proibindo isso explicitamente (no cinematic bokeh, no film look, no color grading, deep focus with everything sharp).

Aumente o realismo de smartphone pedindo auto-exposure/auto white balance readjusting on pans, slight highlight clipping, autofocus hunting on fast pans, e digital zoom quality drop + extra shake.

Trave a continuidade da locação dizendo “same block for the entire take” e descrevendo âncoras ambientais consistentes (brick facades, fire escapes, sidewalk café, parked cars).

Restrinja o áudio especificando apenas raw street ambience e excluindo explicitamente music, captions e watermark.

Use imagens de referência dos personagens com uma regra rígida de CHARACTER LOCK (face/hair/skin/build/clothing never change; no swapping) para manter a consistência da identidade.

Evite reaparições indesejadas delimitando no tempo a aparição de cada personagem (por exemplo, “Appears ONLY at 0:09–0:13”) e adicionando “no stand-ins/doubles/background extras resembling named characters.”

Faça o storyboard do clipe inteiro com beats marcados por timestamp (0:00–0:05, 0:05–0:09, etc.) e descreva a transição exata de câmera entre os beats (flip to rear camera, whip RIGHT, slide+zoom, tilt up, swing forward/left).

Imponha a continuidade de roupa/rosto entre momentos separados adicionando uma regra explícita de consistência (por exemplo, o vlogger em 0:28 deve corresponder exatamente a 0:00).

Mantenha o telefone fora do quadro dizendo “the vlogger’s phone IS the camera—it never appears on screen.”

zh.content:
请在一开始就明确指定拍摄格式和设备风格（Vertical 9:16、smartphone vlog、shot on iPhone），以锁定整体美学。

通过明确提示 ONE SINGLE UNINTERRUPTED HANDHELD TAKE，并给出目标时长（例如 ~30 seconds），同时说明 no cuts/no editing，来强制生成连续镜头。

通过列出你想要的具体运镜（quick whip pans、pans/tilts/zooms/walking），并加上 “camera never lingers.”，来控制节奏和镜头语言。

通过提示自然的手部微抖 + 行走时的轻微晃动 + 略带漂浮感的 digital stabilization，来获得真实的手机画面。

通过明确禁止 “cinematic” 漂移（no cinematic bokeh, no film look, no color grading, deep focus with everything sharp），来避免画面过于电影化。

通过提示 auto-exposure/auto white balance 在转动镜头时重新调整、轻微高光削切、fast pans 时 autofocus hunting，以及 digital zoom 画质下降 + 额外抖动，来增强 smartphone 真实感。

通过说明 “same block for the entire take” 并描述一致的环境锚点（brick facades、fire escapes、sidewalk café、parked cars），来锁定地点连续性。

通过指定 raw street ambience only，并明确排除 music、captions 和 watermark，来约束音频。

使用角色参考图，并配合严格的 CHARACTER LOCK 规则（face/hair/skin/build/clothing never change; no swapping），以保持身份一致性。

通过为每个角色的出场设置时间范围（例如，“Appears ONLY at 0:09–0:13”），并添加 “no stand-ins/doubles/background extras resembling named characters.”，来防止不想要的再次出现。

用带时间戳的节拍（0:00–0:05、0:05–0:09 等）为整个片段制作分镜，并描述各节拍之间的准确镜头过渡（flip to rear camera、whip RIGHT、slide+zoom、tilt up、swing forward/left）。

通过添加明确的一致性规则（例如，0:28 的 vlogger must match 0:00 exactly），来确保分离时刻之间的服装/面部连续性。

通过说明 “the vlogger’s phone IS the camera—it never appears on screen.”，来避免手机入镜。
